frontmatter.title: Basic CLI: Mounting and Unmounting Media Devices
frontmatter.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Mounting and Unmounting Media Devices in Linux
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to mount and unmount media devices in Linux using the command line. This guide covers essential CLI commands like `mount`, `umount`, `fdisk`, and `mkfs`, providing a hands-on approach to managing storage devices.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
